default.layout: • Two graves need to be located. • The locations of the graves are random, but one is likely to be generated along the same wall as the "Memorial Gate" (the next boss area). • Otherwise, they tend to form along the walls of the structure. • Two tombs are also adorned with patterns that run along the walls on each side. The recommended approach is to first look along the same wall as the memorial site. . Once you find a grave, it's usually located either near it or along the opposite wall. • There is a spot (a sarcophagus) that always gives a ring, usually along the wall opposite the waypoint. It can drop an Iron Ring (adds flat damage), which is strong, so attack builds should actively go for it.
default.tips: • The order in which to clear "Tomb of the Consort" and "Mausoleum of the Praetor" is as follows: First, enter "Mausoleum of the Praetor" once, then immediately exit, and then proceed to "Tomb of the Consort". This will raise the level of "Tomb of the Consort" to level 9. . • This approach improves experience efficiency and also allows players to obtain items with a level 11 base, which are +2 levels higher, from the boss in area level 9. This increases the opportunities for equipment upgrades. Note: As an example, the "Warden Bow" is based on level 11. If you don't do this, you'll only be able to obtain Level 5 bows. However, items like crossbows, spears, and talismans that start at level 10 (such as sturdy crossbows, hunting spears, and Cinderbark Talisman) are the next level to upgrade, so from a purely equipment-focused perspective, you don't need to use them. The best approach is to use the weapons you prefer, but since the experience points are so generous, the conclusion is that it's beneficial to do them regardless.
